stories.title: Peralta to Chicago? Where does Skubal land? Best fits for top MLB free agents
stories.summary: Free agency starts at 5 p.m. ET on Monday. Here are some pairings we'd love to see as this offseason gets underway.

stories.title: Way-Too-Early 2027 MLB Power Rankings: Are the Brewers No. 1?
stories.summary: Milwaukee just won the 2026 World Series -- and we're already looking ahead to next year.

stories.title: Morant, hurt against Grizzlies, to miss at least four weeks
stories.summary: Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant sustained a left hamstring strain in his first game against the Grizzlies, his former team, and will be out at least four weeks.

stories.title: Beer-fueled Brewers take to streets, continue World Series party
stories.summary: Tens of thousands of exuberant Brewers fans flooded the streets of downtown Milwaukee to celebrate the franchise's first World Series title with a parade and victory rally.

stories.title: UConn's Hurley gets 2-year extension, now signed through 2032
stories.summary: UConn coach Dan Hurley has signed a two-year extension that puts him under contract through the 2031-32 season and maintains his annual salary of roughly $8 million.
